subject: Audit readiness sprint + term extension / seat increase (SOC 2 evidence request)
messages:
From: Alice Zhang <alice@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 package + renewal asks

Hi Soojin,

We’re starting our vendor recertification for January renewal and I wanted to get a head-start on the SOC 2 / audit evidence we’ll need from Redwood. Two things we’re hoping to cover:

- A snapshot of retained audit logs for the last 12 months and an explanation of retention windows (especially around KV cache and request metadata).
- A sample bundle of evidence we can hand to our auditors (config exports, log delivery examples, and any integrity/hash verification you provide).

Separately, the team is evaluating a 12-month term extension and wants to add +20 seats and a ~10% concurrent capacity uplift for a new feature rollout. If we can get the compliance package in Q4, that will help accelerate procurement.

Can you confirm what you can share and a rough timeline for a deliverable? Happy to set up a 30-min sync if easier.

Thanks,
Alice Zhang
Security Manager, Acme Cloud
alice@acme.com

Attachment: none
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice@acme.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 package + renewal asks

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear outline. We can absolutely support a Q4 evidence sprint. Proposed immediate plan:

1) Evidence tracker: we’ll populate a shared sheet with scoping and ETA (I’m attaching the tracker).
2) Artifact delivery: sample logs, retention policy docs, and export of relevant config snapshots (IAM roles, audit pipelines).
3) Integrity: we can include SHA256 manifest files for delivered log bundles and a short note on the transport guarantees.
4) Capacity/terms: looping in Lauren for pricing and Marcus for capacity headcount & capacity uplift options.

Proposed meeting times this week: Tue 10/3 11:00–11:30 PT or Wed 10/4 14:00–14:30 PT. Which works for you?

I’ve attached the evidence_request_tracker.xlsx — we’ll update it with owners and delivery dates once Priyom confirms.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachment: evidence_request_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice@acme.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 package + renewal asks — artifacts & retention

Hi Alice — quick technical note on what we can deliver and timelines: 

- Retention windows: our platform maintains request/audit logs for 365 days for enterprise customers by default; we also offer 3yr cold archive on request.
- Artifact list we’ll produce: export of request logs (CSV slices), config snapshot (YAML), ingestion pipeline diagram, and a delivery manifest with SHA256 hashes.
- Delivery ETA: we can produce the initial bundle (sample logs + manifest + config snapshot) within 5 business days after scope sign-off. Full archive exports (if you want the full 12 months) may take up to 7–10 business days depending on volume.

I’m attaching our log-transport-playbook which describes the pipeline and guarantees for delivery and integrity (transport + at-rest). A few clarifying questions to help scope:
- Do your auditors need proof of chain-of-custody (e.g., signed time-stamped manifests) or is a manifest with SHA256 sufficient?
- Rough expected log volume (GB) for the 12-month export — helps us estimate export window and any burst capacity.

Marcus — per the capacity ask (10% uplift + +20 seats), what do you want me to include in the technical footer of the term-sheet?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Applied Security, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachment: log-transport-playbook.pdf (doc stub)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice@acme.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 package + renewal asks — term & MAP

Alice — great to align. High level commercial response: 

- Term: We can support a 12-month extension with a 7% loyalty discount off committed usage if signed by 2028-11-15.
- Seats: +20 seats added to current commitment — priced at list less a 5% bundle discount; we can stage seat onboarding over two quarters.
- Capacity uplift: We’ll provision a 10% concurrent capacity uplift with a 30-day evaluation window; if load is sustained we’ll convert to a permanent reserve (pricing in the attached term-sheet).

Attached is the term-sheet (term-sheet-acme-v2.pdf) and a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) included in the doc. If the compliance deliverables are accepted as part of the audit, we’ll fast-track procurement and aim for invoicing aligned with the term start date.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm the evidence scope in the tracker.
- We schedule a 30-min technical walk and a 15-min commercial check.
- I’ll open a DocuSign envelope pending your sign-off on the MAP.

Soojin — please confirm the meeting time you proposed and Marcus — will you confirm the burst / export cost assumptions?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: term-sheet-acme-v2.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Alice Zhang <alice@acme.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Eric Molina <eric.molina@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Oct 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 package + renewal asks — confirmation and a couple clarifications

Thanks team — this all looks good. Quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

- Auditors prefer a signed time-stamped manifest for chain-of-custody; would you be able to provide an optionally vaulted signed manifest or we can accept an auditable timestamp from an HSM/KMS?
- For the export volume: I’ll confirm exact GBs but expect ~1.2TB for the 12-month window (request logs + access traces). Please flag any implications for export scheduling if that’s larger than your usual samples.

We’ll confirm the 10/4 14:00 PT technical walk — I can make that. If possible, include an appendix that lists which controls map to each artifact (even a short table). That will speed auditor review.

Looking forward — if we can get the signed MAP in the next week we’ll target the extension and seat add in Q1 billing.

Best,
Alice Zhang
Security Manager, Acme Cloud
alice@acme.com

Attachment: sample-log-hashes.txt (text stub)
